title: Record form: text that is not a coordinate pair in a location field clears the stored location and reports the save as successful
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect (user-visible data loss with a success message, reproduced twice).

QA-source: #32135 · records-forms.crud-roundtrip · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Typing text that is not a coordinate pair into a location field and saving clears the stored location and shows a success toast. No validation message appears.

## Reproduction (framework ff04ad81, stock showcase)

1. Open any Account record → Edit.
2. Type `Shenzhen 深圳` into Headquarters (`input[name=hq]`, placeholder "latitude, longitude").
3. Click Update.

- Expected: an inline validation error on the field, as the form already shows for Tax ID; nothing is written.
- Actual: the dialog closes and the toast reads `Account … updated`. The PATCH carries `"hq": null` (plus every other field of the record), and the stored `hq` is now null. Entering `22.54, 114.05` works.

## Reach

The record form, any user who edits a record with a location field.

## Why it matters

A user who types an address where coordinates are expected silently loses the location that was there, and is told the save succeeded.

## Reader

Triage first touch; the fix lands in `ui/` (the location field's parse in the form). A second observation from the same edit, for whoever takes it: a no-real-change edit sends the whole record in the PATCH, while a real single-field edit sends only that field.

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack location field invalid input` (151, open and closed), `location field hq` (8): no card for this; #2735 (seed crash on location values) is a different defect.
